purpose: Controlled injection bench on prism 2: copies of the frozen tile partitions with known perturbations (whole-tile ALS registration offsets; MVS holes / noise / bias and ALS lift in 3 m patches placed on baseline-compatible planar cells), each run through surface patches -> XY pairing -> T1 -> T2 with the frozen drivers. Truth labels are stored per point and per cell. Evidence-level calibration only; no responsibility, weight, registration or change verdict.

current_cameras.view_selection: the exact view list frozen by the T1 evidence bank (evidence_views.json)
current_cameras.image_use: 2D-a inter-view photometric consistency and 2D-b image edges only; no model colour; image bytes are hashed against the T1 view list

patch_rule.semantics: 3 m grid over the prism; a grid square is a candidate when >= 80 % of its 0.5 m top-layer cells are COMPATIBLE and planar in the baseline pairing; 30 % of candidates are drawn with the seed; the same set is used by every patch variant; select_fraction raised from 0.3 to 0.6 before the first chain run because the compatible planar zone of prism 2 yields only 25 candidate squares (8 patches / 72 m2 would leave too few injected cells); disclosed in the design

expectations_before_run.V7_vs_V8: V7 (MVS biased up) shows 3D-b BLOCK dominant and 2D-a delta < 0 (P explains the images); V8 (ALS lifted) shows PENETRATE dominant and delta > 0: opposite signs in both channels
expectations_before_run.V5: MVS pairs 0, NO_LANDING dominant, S_P stays >= 0.6 (the images do not contradict P)
expectations_before_run.V1_V2_V3: compatible cells move to PRIOR_ABOVE from delta_z 0.5 with PENETRATE and delta > 0 (the sequential reading confuses registration with change); dz across cells is coherent (variance <= 0.1 m2, sign agreement >= 0.95), unlike V8's local patches
expectations_before_run.V4: horizontal 1 m shift is unobservable on horizontal ground (dz ~ 0, delta ~ 0); signal only on slopes / walls
